summary: Separate dedicated backup, authority-proof and replication export latency operation classes

replay.detail: In-memory request diagnostics only; no source or projection replay.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or SQL changes.

rules.detail: Interactive local/remote read, projection-fresh and write-ack targets and populations remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Request-latency routes retain existing rows and gain scope=export-operation rows with operation_class=backup-export, authority-proof-export or replication-export. Each class counts completed envelopes from dedicated routes, independently of the route-table cap. These overlap route totals: consumers must select a scope, not sum scopes. Shared mailbox pages are not relabeled as exports because the route alone cannot distinguish listing from export.

manual.detail: No operator steps. No export latency target is invented or interactive target raised.

recovery.detail: Counters reset on process restart. Ordinary binary rollback leaves durable data unchanged.
